title: Cyrus and the Ember
author: Hazel Thackeray
blurb: Lior Whitlock, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
